purpose: Typed journey transport and explicit content-consistency review, without automatic semantic or mastery certification
activation: Existing teach-me learning journey; no activation for ordinary execution or quick facts
delivery: existing public MIT GitHub repository and release

files.content_files: legacy seven plus first three typed files; exclude receipt from own fingerprint

transport.proposal: matching UTF-8 source hash and exact quote spans required; unresolved draft references allowed; never auto apply
transport.graph: existing normalized graph validation, graph-only; unresolved endpoints may remain with warnings
transport.receipt: strict shape accepted as historical data even if stale; freshness verified separately

review.summary: Literal progress goal/current_stage/next_action and assessment/evidence counts plus typed presence/warnings; false semantic_correctness_verified
review.freshness: sha256 plus size for every present allowlisted content file, required core three; canonical packet digest excluding own hash
commands: record --journey DIR --packet PACKET --decisions DECISIONS --output RECEIPT [--expected-output-sha256 HASH]
review.replacement: create-new by default; expected digest replacement only canonical journey-review.json, preserve exact previous bytes in journey-review.previous.json; never overwrite other journey content
review.semantics: Operator judgment recorded, no authenticated human/permission/truth/mastery assertion

checks: exact typed pack/unpack and snapshot/restore bytes
v1 still readable; typed smuggling under v1 refused
proposal hash and quote mismatch rejected including merged combinations
receipt schema and derived readiness validation
stale packet/receipt detected after content edit; stale receipt transported unchanged
all four exact nonempty decisions; needs_changes exit1
existing output and wrong replacement hash preserve foreign bytes
legacy125tests unchanged plus independent frozen failures
actual model workflow cases and independent review; no real efficacy claims
all4CIplatformjobs; installed suite; native userscope discovery; pinned source and actual release downloads/hash verification

routing.model: inherited current context, effective setting unknown
routing.router: No qualified configured task route; planner status missing linked/oversized input; no weakening
